notes: 15 shoots per rebar because DuPont Wharf shoots were large (~50 cm canopy height). Plots were placed along a trasect 2 meters south of the light sensor. site_name: Quartermaster Harbor - PNNL - Test Plot 4S - 2021
notes: 20 shoots per rebar as DuPont Wharf shoots were large (~50 cm canopy height). Transplant plots start at 5 m west of light sensor and were planted on either side of the tape at 5 m, 6 m, and 7 m (shallow - deep). 3 rebar with 20 shoots each placed deep and 3 rebar placed shallow to span from 5 m to 5.5 m, 6 m to 6.5 m, and 7 m to 7.5 m.

site_name: Quartermaster Harbor - PNNL - Test Plot 4S - 2022
notes: planted 3 upside down TERFS with 25 shoots attached with hemp cord and electrical tape wrapped around a rhizome segment and metal of the TERFS. Goal was to determine if plants could survive in water column without contact with sediment. Possible stressor is grazing by crabs as observed in 2021. TERFS were placed approximately 2 m northwest of light sensor and separated by approximately 1 m.
